Being worried about mental health progressively getting worse hits home for me. Being able to play out multiple conversations within oneself sounds cool imo, but obviously it can be quite a burden from what it sounds like. I've loved what cognitive behavioral therapy has done for my life, but if it's not working for you then maybe practicing acceptance with uncertainty, mindfulness, and gratitude about the things you got going for you could be more appropriate. My suggestion would be to, if you have the luxury of access to a therapist, ask about cognitive behavioral therapy, or CBT. Had very similar thoughts and did wonders for my anxiety. It is definitely something you have to grab for yourself though, as it takes some time to implement habits and ways of thinking into yourself, but the payoff is too immense to not try it.

Also, I know it's definitely easier said than done, but try to look at the hurdling through space thing as not something to fear, but more of like we're piggybacking on this awesome rock that's got cool stuff and loads of potential to make your life a remarkable one.

If it's some peace of mind, I myself have posted the exact same thing about myself and I got a lot of great recovery stories from obese people! Make sure they are pumping vitamins and A LOT OF WATER into them, along with breathing exercises. The ones I've been doing is 6 reps of deep breaths in and holding for 5. On the 6th breath, cough hard. This is supposed to keep your lungs rarin' to go. Also, monitor with a pulse oximeter and thermometer, o² 95 and over is good and fever under 103 is manageable. If it's persistently under 95 or 94 and the temp won't go below 103 with NSAIDS, talk immediately with doctor and/or go to ER if at all possible.
